opening.argument: The presenter leads with four bullish Polkadot signals and a possible reversal, grounding the discussion in chart-based market analysis. The indicator promotion and its buy zones are part of that discussion, but they do not turn a forecast into a report of completed transactions or victim outcomes. The description identifies the material as educational and informational chart analysis and expressly states that profit is not guaranteed. Although viewers are directed to access the Crusader Indicator, the cited material does not establish a deceptive mechanism.
